## Copy the template

Find the Template repo for creating skills/experience portfolio at:

<https://github.com/TeachHealthData/workshop-portfolio-template>

Find and click the green "Use this template" button (somewhere top-right?)

![](images/use-template.png)

## Name the repo

You will be asked to name your repository  
The name you choose will form the URL for your website

- Name it meaningfully
- And professionally!

:::{.r-stack}
![](images/naming-website-repo.png){.fragment left=0 width=1000}

![](images/naming-website-repo-annotated.png){.fragment left=0 width=1000}
:::


## Create your repo

Hit the green "Create repository" button (bottom)

![](images/create-repo.png){fig-align='center'}

## Deploying your site

:::{.columns}
:::{.column}
Click "Settings" in the top nav-bar 

Click "Pages" in the left side bar 
:::

:::{.column}
![](images/settings-menu.png)

![](images/pages-sidebar-link.png)
:::
:::

## Actions

Under "Build and deployment" click "GitHub Actions"

:::{.r-stack}
![](images/deployment-options-branch.png){.fragment}

![](images/deployment-options-actions.png){.fragment}
:::

## Update our site (1)

The __next time we change our content__ github will automatically run the instructions in `/.github/workflows/`

To make an update here on github, Click on the `<> Code` tab

![](images/navbar-code-tab.png)


## Update our site (2)

:::{.columns}
:::{.column}
- Click the file `about.qmd`
:::

:::{.column}
![](images/select-about-file.png)
:::
:::

## Update our site (3)

- Click the pencil icon (top right)

![](images/edit-about.png)

- Add some change

![](images/commit-about-changes.png)

- And click the green commit button (top right)
- Add a commit message, and click "Commit changes" (bottom right)

![](images/finish-commit.png)

## Return to main page

Click the `<Code>` button in the main nav-bar

![](images/navbar-code-tab.png)


- You should now see a wee yellow dot...
    - (if not, it may just be that the page has not updated)

![](images/yellow-dot.png)

- If it is there, you can click on it...

:::{.r-stack}
![](images/pending-check-1.png){.fragment}

![](images/pending-check-2.png){.fragment}

![](images/successful-checks.png){.fragment}
:::

- You can click the Actions tab in the main nav bar to see the actual progress of task as it updates.
- Just wait for GitHub to do its thing in the background
    - will take a couple of minutes (it should change to a green tick, but might not 🤷)

## While we wait...

Click the cog in the about section (top right)

![](images/about-cog.png)

Give a short description and tick the box as shown

![](images/use-pages-url2.png)

You should now see your website url under the cog you clicked in the about section
